title: Shimmer Ridge

[[Image:Shimmer Ridge.jpg|thumb|300px|Shimmer Ridge]]
'''Shimmer Ridge''' is located in northern [[Dun Morogh]], west of the [[Gates of Ironforge]]. The ridge is inhabited by [[Frostmane clan|Frostmane]] [[troll]]s, who grow [[Shimmerweed]] and dwell in two camps connected by a bridge. Young adventurers seek Shimmer Ridge out in order to collect the shimmer weed for an especially tasty ale recipe.
